events.text: Implemented selection surgery as an Outliner Locate verb. It reads the host-owned selection, maps numeric topology owners to range-ranked Outliner rows, focuses the owning row, and restores the exact selection after the ordinary scope switch clears it. Mixed-owner selections are banked and cycle one owner at a time; unowned, truncated, hidden, unstamped, or changing selections refuse visibly. Native edge consumers now intersect raw selection bits with active scope, preventing stale sibling edges from entering Chamfer or other topology tools. TS resolver test, full cart bundle, and ReleaseFast test-mesh-edit passed.

resolution: Added an Outliner selection-surgery verb: select visible vertices, edges, or faces, press the amber Locate icon, and the editor focuses the row that actually owns them while preserving the exact selection. If corruption mixed owners, repeated presses cycle the bank owner-by-owner and restore only the active owner’s subset. Refusals are explicit for unowned, hidden, truncated, unstamped, or changed topology. Hardened native edge-tool boundaries so stale selections outside the active Outliner scope cannot participate in Chamfer or other topology operations. Verified the pure owner resolver, bundled the full editor cart, and passed the ReleaseFast mesh-edit unit gate with a regression injecting cross-owner stale edge bits.
